jobs.title: Product Manager - Hearing Aids
jobs.description:
Purpose of the Job

The Product Manager ensures Phonak has a highly appealing, commercially successful, and operationally executable product offering for the assigned product scope. The role manages the product workstream across the full lifecycle, contributes to the product launches within the responsible category, and ensures strong cross-functional execution from concept to post-launch optimization.

Tasks & Responsibilities

• Develop the 4Ps for assigned products across concepts, launch preparation, in-market management, and lifecycle support.

• Lead product definition, product vision, use-case refinement, feature prioritization, and value proposition development in partnership with R&D, UX, and category leadership.

• Contribute within launches and ensure timely delivery of successful value propositions across multiple product domains, accessories, and supporting deliverables.

• Translate customer needs, unmet needs, technical trends, benchmarks, and competitor insights into product requirements and product improvements.

• Trigger or support feasibility studies, market trials, field tests, and technology projects to improve product-market fit and launch quality.

• Ensure regulatory and launch-readiness compliance of products, packaging, documentation, and other required deliverables.

• Steer product KPIs including adoption, quality, market feedback, margin implications, and product performance, and recommend corrective actions.

• Support lifecycle activities such as engineering changes, complexity reduction, phase-in and phase-out planning, and post-launch improvement initiatives.

• Work closely with Audiological and Clinical Excellence team to deliver meaning clinical evidence

Key accountabilities

• Commercial and customer success of assigned products.

• Quality of product definition, proposition, launch readiness, and post-launch improvement actions.

• Cross-functional execution across R&D, regulatory, quality, operations, MarCom, and regional teams.

• Lifecycle performance, including product quality, change control support, and phase-in or phase-out execution.

Requirements

• University degree in audiology, engineering, business, or a related discipline.

• Strong experience in product management, launch management, or lifecycle management in medical, healthcare, or technical products.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional work, solve ambiguous problems, and deliver in a matrix organization.

• 4 - 6 years’ experience in global Product Management with focus on product development

• Experience in healthcare or medical industry is an asset

• Running complex projects on global scale

• Focusing on customer experience to define valuable hardware and accessories

• Combination of strong technical background and business acumen

• Able to manage different stakeholder expectations

• Visionary

• Strong cross-functional leadership and management skills

• Highly self-motivated and disciplined

• Creative and imaginative, able to think outside the box

descriptionByLocale.it:
Scopo del lavoro

Il Product Manager assicura che Phonak abbia un'offerta di prodotti altamente accattivante, di successo commerciale ed eseguibile operativamente per l'ambito di applicazione del prodotto assegnato. Il ruolo gestisce il flusso di lavoro del prodotto attraverso il ciclo di vita completo, contribuisce al lancio del prodotto all'interno della categoria responsabile e garantisce una forte esecuzione trasversale dal concetto all'ottimizzazione post-lancio.

Compiti e responsabilità

• Sviluppare i 4P per i prodotti assegnati attraverso concetti, preparazione di lancio, gestione del mercato e supporto del ciclo di vita.

• Definizione del prodotto di piombo, visione del prodotto, raffinatezza dell'uso-case, priorità delle caratteristiche e sviluppo della proposizione del valore in collaborazione con R&D, UX e leadership di categoria.

• Contribuire all'interno dei lanci e garantire la consegna tempestiva di proposizioni di valore di successo in più domini di prodotto, accessori e supporti consegnabili.

• Traduci le esigenze dei clienti, le esigenze non soddisfatte, le tendenze tecniche, i benchmark e le informazioni dei concorrenti sui requisiti dei prodotti e sui miglioramenti dei prodotti.

• Trigger o sostenere studi di fattibilità, prove di mercato, test sul campo e progetti tecnologici per migliorare la vestibilità del mercato del prodotto e la qualità di lancio.

• Assicurare la conformità normativa e la disponibilità di prodotti, imballaggi, documentazione e altri materiali di consegna richiesti.

• Steer prodotto KPIs tra cui adozione, qualità, feedback di mercato, implicazioni di margine e prestazioni del prodotto, e raccomanda azioni correttive.

• Sostenere le attività del ciclo di vita come i cambiamenti di ingegneria, la riduzione della complessità, il phase-in e le iniziative di miglioramento post-launch.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con il team Audiological and Clinical Excellence per fornire prove cliniche di significato

Capacità di contabilità chiave

• Il successo commerciale e del cliente dei prodotti assegnati.

• Qualità della definizione del prodotto, proposizione, disponibilità di lancio e azioni di miglioramento post-lancio.

• Esecuzione cross-funzionale in R&D, regolazione, qualità, operazioni, MarCom e squadre regionali.

• Prestazioni del ciclo di vita, tra cui la qualità del prodotto, il supporto di controllo del cambiamento e l'esecuzione phase-in o phase-out.

Requisiti

• Laurea in audiologia, ingegneria, business o una disciplina correlata.

• Forte esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nella gestione del lancio o nella gestione del ciclo di vita in prodotti medici, sanitari o tecnici.

• Prove capacità di condurre il lavoro interfunzionale, risolvere problemi ambigui, e consegnare in un'organizzazione di matrice.

• 4 - 6 anni di esperienza nella gestione globale dei prodotti con particolare attenzione allo sviluppo dei prodotti

• L'esperienza nel settore sanitario o medico è un bene

• Progetti complessi in esecuzione su scala globale

• Concentrandosi sull'esperienza del cliente per definire hardware e accessori preziosi

• Combinazione di forte background tecnico e business acumen

• In grado di gestire diverse aspettative degli stakeholder

• Visione

• Forte capacità di leadership e gestione trasversali

• Altamente automotivato e disciplinato

• Creativo e fantasioso, in grado di pensare al di fuori della scatola

jobs.title: Product Cybersecurity Expert
jobs.description:
As a Product Cybersecurity Expert , you will play a key role in ensuring cybersecurity is embedded into the development of Sonova's connected hearing solutions—from embedded software and mobile applications to cloud-based services.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, architects, quality, and regulatory experts, you'll help integrate security into every stage of the product development lifecycle. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

jobs.title: Architect Charging Solutions
jobs.description:
Would you like to shape the architecture behind the next generation of charging solutions for hearing devices?

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, covering electronics, embedded software, mechanical interfaces and connectivity across the wider product ecosystem. You will define scalable platform architecture, guide development teams and suppliers, and turn complex requirements into robust, reusable solutions.

More about the role

• Take technical and architectural ownership of the Charging Solutions domain, guiding the development team, setting priorities and supporting effective delivery.

• Design charging architectures spanning electronics and embedded software, while ensuring effective integration with mechanical components.

• Define strategic, reusable platform elements and interfaces between chargers, hearing instruments, production software and application software.

• Translate customer, system and stakeholder needs into solutions that balance functionality, performance, quality, cost and long-term maintainability.

• Review electronic schematics, embedded software architecture and selected code, with hands-on programming representing approximately 10–20% of the role.

• Work closely with external suppliers, review their technical solutions and influence architectural decisions throughout the development chain.

• Make sound technical decisions in complex or uncertain situations and ensure compliance with medical-device, cybersecurity and privacy requirements.

• Document and communicate architectural decisions while promoting technical learning, best practices and continuous improvement across teams.

More about you

Must have

• A Master’s degree or equivalent in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems or a related technical discipline.

• At least five years of professional experience in hardware and/or embedded software development, including hands-on experience with charging solutions.

• Strong knowledge of electrical hardware and electronic schematics, combined with a solid understanding of embedded software architecture and the ability to review code.

• Experience designing complex hardware–software systems and managing dependencies across electronics, software, mechanics and connected applications.

• A pragmatic and decisive approach, with the ability to navigate uncertainty, evaluate technical trade-offs and drive solutions forward.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical groups and influence internal stakeholders and external suppliers.

• Strong communication and negotiation skills, together with professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience designing reusable platforms or modular product architectures.

• Experience working in a regulated environment, particularly in the medical-device industry.

• An architecture certification, such as iSAQB, or a PhD in a relevant technical field.

• Experience in technical leadership, agile development or technology assessment.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

Vorresti modellare l'architettura dietro la nuova generazione di soluzioni di ricarica per apparecchi acustici?

In questo ruolo, prenderete la proprietà tecnica del dominio Charging Solutions, coprendo elettronica, software incorporato, interfacce meccaniche e connettività attraverso il più ampio ecosistema di prodotti. Definirai l'architettura scalabile della piattaforma, i team di sviluppo guida e i fornitori, e trasformerai i requisiti complessi in soluzioni robuste e riutilizzabili.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Prendere la proprietà tecnica e architettonica del dominio Charging Solutions, guidare il team di sviluppo, impostare le priorità e sostenere la consegna efficace.

• Architetture di ricarica per la progettazione che spaziano dall'elettronica e dal software incorporato, garantendo un'efficace integrazione con componenti meccanici.

• Definire elementi di piattaforma strategici e riutilizzabili e interfacce tra caricabatterie, strumenti acustici, software di produzione e software di applicazione.

• Tradurre il cliente, il sistema e le esigenze degli stakeholder in soluzioni che bilanciano funzionalità, prestazioni, qualità, costi e manutenbilità a lungo termine.

• Rivedere gli schemi elettronici, l'architettura software incorporata e il codice selezionato, con la programmazione hands-on che rappresenta circa il 10-20% del ruolo.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i fornitori esterni, rivedere le loro soluzioni tecniche e influenzare le decisioni architettoniche in tutta la catena di sviluppo.

• Prendere decisioni tecniche solide in situazioni complesse o incerte e garantire il rispetto dei requisiti medici-dispositivi, sicurezza informatica e privacy.

• Documentare e comunicare le decisioni architettoniche promuovendo l'apprendimento tecnico, le migliori pratiche e il miglioramento continuo delle squadre.

Più di te

Devo

• Laurea Magistrale o equivalente in ingegneria elettrica o elettronica, informatica, sistemi incorporati o una disciplina tecnica correlata.

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza professionale nello sviluppo hardware e/o software integrato, tra cui esperienza pratica con soluzioni di ricarica.

• Forte conoscenza dell'hardware elettrico e degli schemi elettronici, combinato con una solida comprensione dell'architettura software incorporata e la capacità di rivedere il codice.

• Scopri la progettazione di sistemi hardware-software complessi e la gestione delle dipendenze tra elettronica, software, meccanica e applicazioni connesse.

• Un approccio pragmatico e decisivo, con la capacità di navigare in incertezza, valutare i trade-off tecnici e far avanzare soluzioni.

• Prove capacità di condurre gruppi tecnici interfunzionali e influenzare gli stakeholder interni e i fornitori esterni.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e di negoziazione, insieme alla fluidità professionale in inglese.

Che bello avere

• Esperienza nella progettazione di piattaforme riutilizzabili o architetture di prodotti modulari.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente regolamentato, in particolare nel settore medico-dispositivo.

• Una certificazione di architettura, come iSAQB, o un dottorato in un campo tecnico rilevante.

• Esperienza nella leadership tecnica, sviluppo agile o valutazione della tecnologia.

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

Processo di applicazione

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, non vede l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione tramite la nostra piattaforma di applicazione del lavoro online, compreso il vostro CV e lettera di copertura. Per questa vacanza, saranno considerate solo applicazioni dirette.

jobs.description:
As a Hardware Verification Engineer - Charging Systems (m/f/d), you will play a key role in ensuring the performance, safety and reliability of our charging solutions for hearing devices.

You will combine hands-on electronics testing with Python-based test automation, developing test setups and verification methods that bring our products through development and towards market readiness. Working at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and system verification, you will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to turn complex technical requirements into robust, measurable and reliable solutions.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of verification activities throughout the product lifecycle while contributing directly to products that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.

More about the role

• Design, build, calibrate and continuously improve test setups and measurement benches for the verification of charging solutions

• Develop and maintain automated verification frameworks and test scripts, with a strong focus on Python

• Plan and execute experiments to assess charging behavior, power management, performance and safety mechanisms under realistic usage conditions

• Translate system requirements, design specifications and risk analyses into effective test conditions, test cases and test procedures

• Investigate test failures, analyze measurement data, identify root causes and collaborate with development teams to drive corrective actions

• Process, visualize and document test and measurement data to provide clear evidence of product performance and verification results

• Collaborate closely with hardware, embedded software and system engineers as well as Test Managers, external partners and colleagues across different sites

More about you

• BSc or MSc degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field

• Around 3–6 years of experience in verification and testing of electronic systems, ideally combining hardware and embedded firmware

• Strong Python skills for test automation, data processing and analysis

• Hands-on experience developing custom test setups using Raspberry Pi, Arduino or similar MCU-based platforms, combined with solid electronics and measurement know-how

• Practical experience troubleshooting electronic devices and a structured approach to root-cause analysis and problem solving

• A proactive, quality-focused and collaborative mindset with the ability to work independently in an international, cross-functional environment

• Excellent English communication skills; German skills are an advantage

Experience with medical device development, C#, MATLAB, test management or relevant safety and regulatory standards is considered an advantage.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

jobs.description:
As Senior Manager Sound Quality Engineering , you will lead a team responsible for evaluating and optimizing the sound quality and performance of Sonova's hearing solutions.

Working closely with experts across Signal Processing, Audiology, Software Engineering, Verification, and other R&D functions, you will ensure that innovative technologies translate into measurable end-user benefit and excellent hearing experiences.

You will guide your team throughout the development process, balancing technical excellence, product quality, timelines and customer value while translating strategic direction into successful execution.

More about the role

• Lead and develop a team of sound quality engineers, creating an environment that fosters collaboration, ownership and continuous development.

• Lead the sound quality engineering activities for Sonova's hearing solutions, ensuring excellent end-user benefit and outstanding hearing experiences.

• Translate strategic roadmaps into clear priorities and actionable objectives for your team.

• Guide the development, verification, and optimization of new hearing functions and technologies together with cross-functional engineering teams.

• Collaborate closely with stakeholders across Signal Processing, Audiology, Software Engineering, Verification and other R&D disciplines.

• Drive evidence-based decisions through technical evaluations, performance measurements and user-focused validation.

• Balance innovation, product quality, technical feasibility, timelines and resources throughout the development process.

• Continuously improve development methods, tools and engineering processes while supporting a culture of learning and innovation.

More about you

Must-have

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Acoustics, Biomedical Engineering or a comparable technical or scientific discipline.

• At least 5 years of professional experience in engineering, acoustics, signal processing or a comparable R&D environment.

• Demonstrated leadership experience, for example by leading projects, technical workstreams or serving as a (deputy) team lead.

• Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing a broad range of technical stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate strategic direction into practical execution.

• Excellent communication skills and the ability to build trust across multidisciplinary teams.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience within the medical device industry.

• Experience in hearing technology or audiology-related products.

• Familiarity with regulated development environments.

More about what we offer

At Sonova, you'll join a purpose-driven company where your work directly improves people's quality of life.

We offer an international and collaborative working environment in which you'll have the opportunity to lead talented engineers, contribute to innovative hearing technologies and continuously grow both professionally and personally.

In addition, you'll benefit from:

• Flexible hybrid working.

• Individual learning and development opportunities.

• Clear career development paths.

• Modern working environment and collaborative culture.

• Competitive compensation and benefits.

• The opportunity to work on technologies that positively impact millions of people worldwide.

Research & Development delivers hearing solutions and services for people with hearing loss, hearing care professionals, and further related people, in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications, and PC software.

As a Power Management Engineer, you will hold a pivotal role in enabling the industry‑leading AI hearing functions that define our next‑generation products. You are the one who ensures that cutting‑edge intelligence is not only possible, but reliably powered every moment. This position sits at the crossroads of multiple technical domains: electronic design, battery innovation, and embedded software, offering a uniquely dynamic environment where your decisions directly shape performance, efficiency, and user experience. It is a role for someone who wants to be at the technological core, driving the energy systems that make advanced hearing AI truly come alive.

.

More about the role

• Design, develop, and optimize battery and power management systems for hearing instruments and charging solutions

• Specify, integrate, and validate power management circuits for rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery systems

• Evaluate, specify, integrate, and optimize Power Management ICs (PMICs) and related power conversion architectures for future hearing instruments and charging systems

• Define and implement battery management algorithms and power strategies, including State of Charge and State of Health estimation, charging behavior, protection mechanisms, and energy optimization

• Collaborate closely with hardware and firmware teams to ensure robust integration of battery and power management functions into the overall hearing instrument and charger architecture

• Develop and validate electrical and system-level models for power consumption, load profiles, and battery behavior under different operating conditions

• Analyze and debug complex power-related system issues, driving root-cause identification and resolution

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of power management platforms, methods, and development processes, and stay informed about emerging technologies and trends

• Evaluate emerging power management technologies and energy management concepts to support future product generations

More about you

• Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field

• Proven experience in the design of power management systems for low-power embedded devices, including DC/DC conversion, load switches, charging circuits, and energy-efficient architectures

• Experience with rechargeable and non-rechargeable battery technologies, as well as a strong understanding of system-level behavior, load profiling, power consumption analysis, and battery aging effects

• Hands-on experience with electrical characterization, laboratory measurements, and data-driven validation of power systems

• Strong programming skills in Python for data analysis, automation, and model development; MATLAB is a plus

• Experience in optimizing ultra-low-power systems under strict energy and size constraints is an asset

• Experience in debugging complex power-related issues in low-power applications and charging systems is an asset

• Structured, proactive, and quality-conscious working style, with the ability to bring forward innovative ideas and collaborate effectively in a distributed, diverse environment

• Fluent in English (spoken and written)

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Employment level 80-100%.

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, references, and certificates) via our online job application platform.

For this vacancy only direct applications will be considered.

Purpose of the Job

The Procurement Project Manager NPI/R&D is responsible for leading the procurement activities associated with new product design and development projects at Sonova AG globally. The position focuses on New Product Introduction (NPI) and Research & Development (R&D).

This role requires a strategic leader with extensive knowledge and operational expertise in Project Procurement, ensuring alignment with the Procurement Policy (POL-61) and Corporate Procurement Procedures (SOP-271). The PPM NPI/R&D will bring a modern approach to the Sonova team and drives projects forward while supporting various procurement functions to create value and enhance the organization’s competitive advantage.

This position presents an excellent opportunity within a fast-paced growth company to deliver significant value in both Concept and Project phases. The successful candidate will demonstrate previous value-add ownership of projects in a global environment, with the ability to interact cross-functionally and externally to achieve real progress for NPI Procurement in line with Sonova's values and business plans.

The Manager must either possess a comprehensive understanding of all Direct Procurement Categories or establish a plan to gain deep insights into all Categories within one year from position assignment. Furthermore, the candidate is expected to develop a thorough understanding of the HI BU Innovation process to effectively contribute to project success.

Additionally, it is expected that the position owner will implement those procurement milestones in Desing and Development process as a minimum:

• Procurement KO: Launch procurement activities 1 month after project kick-off.

• Sourcing KO: Initiate sourcing 2 weeks after design input review/specifications.

• Tool KO: Confirm supplier tool kick-off cca 2 weeks after technical design review.

• Tool Trial: Conduct tool trials cca 3 weeks before prototype or first-off-tool samples.

• Supplier OQ: Ensure performing operational qualification cca 3 weeks before Sonova OQ trial.

• Supplier PQ: Ensure conduct performance qualification cca 3 weeks before Sonova OQ trial.

• Launch Readiness: Confirm preparation for ramp-up 16 weeks before launch.

• Launch Handover: Handover procurement activities to mass production team 3 months after launch.

Tasks & Responsibilities

• Procurement of goods and services in economic terms and with minimal risk, focusing on technical material and services

• Optimal use of procurement potential for the benefit of the whole supply chain

• Main aspect is targeting costing (R&D support), bundling of demand, supplier management, commodity management across all direct Categories in Design & Development phases, stepping also in Concept phases

• Ensuring compliance with the material and supplier strategies defined by Corporate Procurement in product design and development

• Active participation in product development projects (close exchange with project managers, sparring for all procurement issues)

• Safe process and support to product quality in Design and Development including follow-up

• Conducting negotiation with Suppliers within scope of new product introduction

• Actively support product adaptations to reduce costs and/or improve quality

• Collecting, controlling, and analyzing key figures

• Maintenance of material data in SAP until the launch of the product.

• Deputy function on NPI procurement colleague

• Close collaboration with the Corporate Category Leaders/Managers

• Support VAVE (Value Analysis/Value Engineering) Projects to drive down costs

• Bring knowledge of sustainable sourcing practices and opportunities for innovation

• Understand the sourcing demand across the sub-category and sign a contract Statement of Work and new projects pipelines

• Engage with technical and financial stakeholders to generate procurement phase plans that are aligned to strategy and process

• Deliver on planned objectives, e.g., savings and time to source

• Operate compliantly and in accordance with Sonova processes and ways of working

• Understand Design to Cost principles

• Understand and be able to implement negotiation and influencing techniques

• Manage supplier relationships, built on maintaining accurate and current supplier segmentation data and a clear view on supplier preferencing

• Support business process improvement initiatives

Requirements

• Master’s degree in technical or commercial area

• 7+ years of procurement experience in the Directs area with specific knowledge of Project Leads

• Worked experience of owning procurement activities in a global organization

• Ownership of the Procurement processes in line with policy, procedures and sourcing targets

• Fit for purpose contract development

• Adept at supporting the business to resolve supply chain disturbance and supplier performance issues

• Successful commercial experience (pre and post sourcing)

• Able to collaborate with and influence external Suppliers and internal stakeholder groups linked to the relevant sub-category

• Self-starter, self-motivated and ready to play a visible role in procurement

• A value creator, adept at impacting the bottom line through tangible commercial results

• Solutions-focused, able to work with leadership and teammates to deliver the required outcomes

• experience of cost modelling / interacting with cost models and or Should Cost Analysis

• Automotive/Medical/Food sector experience

Il Procurement Project Manager NPI/R&D è responsabile per le attività di approvvigionamento associate a nuovi progetti di progettazione e sviluppo di prodotti della Sonova AG a livello globale. La posizione si concentra sul nuovo prodotto Introduzione (NPI) e ricerca e sviluppo (R&D).

Questo ruolo richiede un leader strategico con una vasta conoscenza e competenze operative nel Project Procurement, assicurando l'allineamento con la politica di approvvigionamento (POL-61) e le procedure di appalti aziendali (SOP-271). Il PPM NPI/R&D porterà un approccio moderno al team Sonova e spinge i progetti in avanti, supportando diverse funzioni di approvvigionamento per creare valore e migliorare il vantaggio competitivo dell’organizzazione.

Questa posizione presenta un'ottima opportunità all'interno di un'azienda di crescita veloce per offrire un valore significativo sia nelle fasi Concept che Project. Il candidato di successo dimostrerà la precedente proprietà del valore aggiunto dei progetti in un ambiente globale, con la capacità di interagire trasversalmente ed esternamente per raggiungere i reali progressi per il Procurement NPI in linea con i valori e i piani di business di Sonova.

Il Manager deve possedere una comprensione completa di tutte le categorie di appalti diretti o stabilire un piano per ottenere approfondimenti in tutte le categorie entro un anno dall'assegnazione della posizione. Inoltre, è previsto che il proprietario di posizione implementerà quelle pietre miliari di approvvigionamento nel processo di Desing e Sviluppo come minimo:

• Procurement KO: Avviare attività di approvvigionamento 1 mese dopo il lancio del progetto.

• Sourcing KO: Iniziate sourcing 2 settimane dopo la revisione/specificazioni di input di progettazione.

• Strumento KO: Conferma strumento fornitore kick-off cca 2 settimane dopo la revisione di progettazione tecnica.

• Tool Trial: Conduct tool trials cca 3 settimane prima del prototipo o del primo-off-tool campioni.

• Fornitore OQ: Assicurarsi di eseguire la qualificazione operativa cca 3 settimane prima del processo Sonova OQ.

• Fornitore PQ: Assicurarsi di condurre la qualifica di prestazione cca 3 settimane prima della prova Sonova OQ.

• Prontezza di lancio: Confermare la preparazione per ramp-up 16 settimane prima del lancio.

• Launch Handover: attività di approvvigionamento di consegna al team di produzione di massa 3 mesi dopo il lancio.

• Acquisti di beni e servizi in termini economici e con rischio minimo, concentrandosi sul materiale tecnico e sui servizi

• Utilizzo ottimale del potenziale di approvvigionamento a beneficio dell'intera catena di fornitura

• L'aspetto principale è il targeting costing (R&D support), bundling della domanda, gestione dei fornitori, gestione delle materie prime in tutte le fasi dirette di progettazione e sviluppo, stepping anche nelle fasi Concept

• Garantire il rispetto delle strategie materiali e dei fornitori definite da Corporate Procurement nella progettazione e nello sviluppo dei prodotti

• Partecipazione attiva ai progetti di sviluppo del prodotto (chiudere lo scambio con i project manager, risparmiando per tutte le questioni di approvvigionamento)

• Processo sicuro e supporto alla qualità del prodotto in Design e Sviluppo, incluso il follow-up

• Condurre la negoziazione con i Fornitori nell'ambito di una nuova introduzione di prodotto

• Supporta attivamente gli adattamenti dei prodotti per ridurre i costi e/o migliorare la qualità

• Raccogliere, controllare e analizzare figure chiave

• Manutenzione dei dati materiali in SAP fino al lancio del prodotto.

• Funzione aggiuntiva del collega degli appalti NPI

• Chiudi la collaborazione con Corporate Categoria Leaders/Managers

• Supporto VAVE (Valore Analisi/Valuta Ingegneria) Progetti per ridurre i costi

• Portare la conoscenza delle pratiche di approvvigionamento sostenibile e delle opportunità di innovazione

• Comprendere la domanda di approvvigionamento attraverso la sottocategoria e firmare un contratto Dichiarazione di lavoro e nuovi progetti pipeline

• Impegnarsi con gli stakeholder tecnici e finanziari per generare piani di fase di approvvigionamento allineati alla strategia e al processo

• Fornire obiettivi pianificati, ad esempio, risparmio e tempo di provenienza

• Operare in modo conforme e conforme ai processi e alle modalità di lavoro di Sonova

• Capire Design ai principi del costo

• Comprendere ed essere in grado di attuare le tecniche di negoziazione e di influenzare

• Gestire le relazioni dei fornitori, costruito sul mantenimento dei dati di segmentazione dei fornitori accurati e attuali e una chiara visione sul preferenziale dei fornitori

• Sostegno alle iniziative di miglioramento dei processi aziendali

Requisiti

• Laurea magistrale in area tecnica o commerciale

• 7+ anni di esperienza di approvvigionamento nell'area Directs con conoscenze specifiche dei Project Leads

• Esperienza lavorativa di possedere attività di approvvigionamento in un'organizzazione globale

• Proprietà dei processi di approvvigionamento in linea con criteri, procedure e obiettivi di approvvigionamento

• Adatto per lo sviluppo del contratto di scopo

• Adept a sostenere il business per risolvere il disturbo della supply chain e problemi di prestazioni dei fornitori

• Esperienza commerciale di successo (pre e post sourcing)

• In grado di collaborare con e influenzare fornitori esterni e gruppi di stakeholder interni collegati alla sottocategoria rilevante

• Autostarter, automotivato e pronto a svolgere un ruolo visibile nell'approvvigionamento

• Un creatore di valore, adept a impatto sulla linea di fondo attraverso risultati commerciali tangibili

• Soluzioni focalizzate, in grado di lavorare con leadership e compagni di squadra per fornire i risultati richiesti

• esperienza di modellazione dei costi / interazione con i modelli di costo e o dovrebbe analisi dei costi

• Esperienza nel settore Automotive/Medical/Food

Are you passionate about solving complex technical challenges where every byte of memory matters?

As an Embedded Software Engineer C++, you will join an experienced team focused on developing deeply embedded firmware for our next generation of hearing devices (medical devices).

This is an opportunity to apply your deep C++ expertise in embedded development. You will work close to the hardware, navigate complex, state-of-the-art development and test environments, and solve challenging problems across the boundaries of software, tooling and hardware.

More about the role

• Develop object-oriented embedded software in modern C++ for resource-constrained wireless hearing devices.

• Contribute to the design and architecture of new functionality, working closely with software architects and interdisciplinary platform teams.

• Develop, document, test, integrate and maintain software throughout the development lifecycle, while ensuring appropriate test coverage and reliable system behavior.

• Debug complex issues directly on target hardware and in simulators.

• Work within state-of-the-art development, build and test environments and contribute to their continuous improvement.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams across mobile and desktop software, firmware, verification and requirements engineering to bring new hearing solutions from concept to product.

More about you

• You have excellent embedded software C++ development know-how, including operating systems, concurrency, communication, distributed systems, and object-oriented design, combined with 5+ years of professional experience.

• You have developed software for highly resource-constrained systems, with limited memory and battery power.

• You are skilled in debugging and comfortable investigating complex issues on actual hardware, including situations where the root cause may lie in software, hardware or the development environment.

• You are familiar with modern embedded software engineering practices and development environments and continuous integration. Knowledge of Python, C#, test frameworks or related tooling is an advantage.

• You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, the natural sciences, or a comparable technical discipline and communicate confidently in English; knowledge of German is a plus.

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. Dal concetto alla fase di distribuzione, sarete impegnati a contribuire a soluzioni software e firmware altamente flessibili e affidabili.

Come Ingegnere di software DSP - Strumenti e infrastrutture, guiderà la progettazione, l'implementazione e la manutenzione di strumenti SW per l'elaborazione di segnali audio incorporati. Questi strumenti consentono lo sviluppo funzionale basato sul modello e lo sviluppo a livello di applicazione incorporato. Rispondono alle esigenze derivanti dallo sviluppo di software integrato per un sistema embedded multiprocessore dedicato all'elaborazione di segnali e reti neurali.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

•
Progettazione ed evoluzione di strumenti di sviluppo software che permettono lo sviluppo di software funzionale basato sul modello e integrato per la lavorazione di reti segnale- e neurali

•
Collabora con gli stakeholder per raccogliere, analizzare e affinare i requisiti per la progettazione e l'implementazione di strumenti di sviluppo software

•
Supporta attivamente la comunicazione e la collaborazione tra i team che sviluppano gli strumenti e le squadre che utilizzano gli strumenti

•
Guidare le migliori pratiche di ingegneria del software attraverso recensioni di progettazione, linee guida tecniche e miglioramento continuo

•
Contribuire alle qualità architettoniche a sostegno dell'integrità concettuale, della modularità, della manutenbilità e dell'estensibilità

Più di te

•
Laurea in scienze informatiche, ingegneria elettrica o settore tecnico correlato

•
4+ anni di esperienza nello sviluppo, distribuzione e manutenzione di sistemi software integrati

•
Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving

•
Proficienza in Python

•
Esperienza con Matlab & Simulink

•
Conoscenza di una (o più) delle seguenti tecnologie: C/C++, Docker, CI/CD (ad esempio Jenkins), Bash

•
Buona comprensione dello sviluppo dell'elaborazione dei segnali, la conoscenza sullo sviluppo della rete neurale è un plus

•
Esperienza con sistemi di elaborazione del segnale in tempo reale è un plus

•
Mindset collaborativo con un approccio orientato al cliente e al servizio

•
Competenze fluide in inglese; tedesco è un plus

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. descriptionByLocale.en:
In our R&D group, we develop hearing solutions and services for hearing impaired people and hearing care professionals in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications and PC software. From the concept to the deployment phase, you will be engaged in contributing to highly flexible and reliable software and firmware solutions.

As a Software Engineer DSP - Tools & Infrastructure, you will drive the design, implementation and maintenance of SW tools for embedded audio signal processing. These tools enable model-based functional development, and embedded application-level development. They address the needs arising in embedded software development for a multi-processor embedded system dedicated to signal- and neural-network processing.

More about the role

•
 Design and evolve software development tools that enable model-based and embedded functional software development for signal- and neural-network processing

•
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and refine requirements for design and implementation of software development tools

•
 Actively support the communication and collaboration between the teams that develop the tools and the teams that use the tools

•
 Drive software engineering best practices through design reviews, technical guidelines, and continuous improvement

•
 Contribute to architectural qualities in support of conceptual integrity, modularity, maintainability and extensibility

More about you

•
 University degree (MSc/BSc) or equivalent in computer science, electrical engineering or related technical field

•
 4+ years of experience in the development, deployment and maintenance of embedded software systems

•
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

•
 Proficiency in Python

•
 Experience with Matlab & Simulink

•
 Knowledge of one (or more) of the following technologies: C/C++, Docker, CI/CD (e.g. Jenkins), Bash

•
 Good understanding of signal processing development, knowledge on Neural Network development is a plus

•
 Experience with real-time signal processing systems is a plus

•
 Collaborative mindset with a customer and service-oriented approach

•
 Fluent skills in English; German is a plus

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. jobs.description:
At Phonak, we develop advanced hearing solutions designed to improve how people experience and connect with the world. As our Senior Product Manager , you will take end-to-end ownership of an assigned product scope and play a leading role in transforming customer, market, and technology insights into commercially successful solutions.

You will lead the product workstream from initial definition through launch, go-to-market execution, performance management, and lifecycle optimization. Acting as a senior product authority, you will develop strong recommendations, align diverse stakeholders, influence key decisions, and coordinate Product Managers contributing to the same category or launch.

This is a high-impact opportunity for an experienced Product Manager who combines commercial judgment, customer focus, strategic thinking, and the ability to drive execution across a complex global organization.

More about the role:

• Own the complete product marketing mix and product strategy across concept development, launch preparation, in-market management, and lifecycle optimization.

• Lead product vision, use-case refinement, feature prioritization, product story, and value proposition development with R&D, UX, Portfolio, and commercial teams.

• Build robust business cases and margin logic for new launches, upgrades, and lifecycle actions using market, cost, customer, and competitive insights.

• Develop pricing logic, price-pack architecture, and value-based pricing recommendations with Pricing and other commercial stakeholders.

• Lead product contributions to global launches and coordinate Product Managers responsible for products, accessories, or dependent launch elements.

• Drive go-to-market readiness across regions and channels, including availability planning, documentation, training inputs, messaging, and operational dependencies.

• Brief and partner with Brand, MarCom, and regional teams on product claims, launch messaging, sales tools, training, and commercial activation.

• Track adoption, quality, customer feedback, margin, competitive performance, and other product KPIs, initiating corrective and lifecycle actions where required.

More about you:

Must haves:

• 5+ years of relevant experience in Product Management, product marketing, strategic marketing or launch management, ideally in a global environment.

• University degree in business, engineering, audiology, marketing or a related field.

• Strong experience managing technically complex products across development, launch, go-to-market and lifecycle activities.

• Strong commercial acumen, including experience with business cases, value propositions, pricing and/or margin considerations.

• Proven ability to develop recommendations, influence decisions and align senior cross-functional stakeholders in a complex matrix organization.

• Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills, combined with strong strategic and execution capabilities.

Nice to haves

• Experience in hearing care, medical devices, healthcare or another regulated industry.

• Technical background or strong experience partnering with R&D/engineering teams.

• Experience coordinating or coaching other Product Managers or leading without formal authority.

• Experience with market trials, customer-centric development and/or Agile/SAFe methodologies

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

jobs.description:
Murten, Switzerland (hybrid)

This role combines software development, automation, and hands-on engineering in an international manufacturing environment. As part of the Manufacturing Engineering team, you will develop equipment, test systems and software used to manufacture and test innovative hearing, communication and consumer products worldwide.

Your responsibilities

•
 Develop manufacturing and test equipment for new products, covering hardware, software and system integration

•
 Create test and configuration sequences using LabVIEW

•
 Develop software interfaces for measurement equipment

•
 Integrate electronic, mechanical and software components into complete manufacturing systems

•
 Validate and qualify equipment before installation at production sites

•
 Maintain and modernize existing manufacturing equipment

•
 Provide second-level support to global production teams, both remotely and occasionally on site

Your profile

•
 At least bachelor’s degree in industrial systems, automation or a related engineering discipline

•
 Around 3 to 5 years of experience in a similar role, ideally involving electronic devices, embedded software or automated manufacturing systems

•
 Strong LabVIEW programming experience

•
 Knowledge of industrial systems and measurement equipment

•
 Experience with PLC automation

•
 Fluent English, strong communication skills and confidence working with different cultures and stakeholder groups

•
 Structured, solution-oriented approach and the ability to manage unexpected technical challenges

Why join us

You will work on varied engineering projects involving different technologies and product types, from medical devices to consumer products and wireless communication solutions. Your systems will support production centers around the world, giving your work a truly global impact.

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. #LI-NB1

At Sonova R&D, we are not just developing hearing devices, we are shaping the future of hearing technology. At the heart of this transformation is the deployment and execution of neural networks on our next-generation embedded platform. This requires innovative tools and firmware infrastructure, giving you the opportunity to directly influence the performance of our products.

As our new Software Engineer Embedded AI you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI and ultra-low-power embedded systems. You will develop the embedded AI software stack that forms the foundation of our next-generation hearing instruments.

Are you excited to explore new technological territory and play a pivotal role in shaping Sonova’s edge AI capabilities? Join us and help rethink how embedded software is built to enhance people’s hearing experience and quality of life.

• Develop firmware for a deeply embedded AI platform operating under strict latency, memory, compute, and energy constraints

• Design, implement, and maintain the embedded AI software stack including optimization for performance, latency, and energy efficiency

• Collaborate with AI and DSP experts to analyze and deploy DNN algorithms in hearing-device applications

• Tailor AI algorithms to the embedded platform and its constraints (e.g., quantization, memory, compute and power)

• Implement prototypes, bring them to production-ready features and integrate them into our system in collaboration with other engineering teams.

• Ensure high software quality through clean-code practices, code reviews, testing, documentation, maintenance, and root-cause analysis

• Continuously improve development methodologies, tools, design patterns, and best practices for efficient ML/DNN development and deployment

More about you

• Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• Strong hands-on experience with embedded C++, Python, and object-oriented programming

• Experience developing and deploying neural networks on embedded systems, including familiarity with deployment frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, TVM, or ExecuTorch

• Knowledge of embedded compilers, micro-NPUs, and system-level simulation

• Experience with CUDA is an advantage

• Knowledge of audio or digital signal processing is an advantage

• Experience in bringing features to products is an advantage

• Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills
